outcome: Maternal plasma levels of cystatin C
Need for neonatal intensive care unit admission
cohort: 108 pregnant women (54 with isolated oligohydramnios and 54 matched controls)
finding: Maternal serum levels of cystatin C and hs-CRP were significantly higher in pregnant women with isolated oligohydramnios and may be useful biomarkers for predicting perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: The study found that women with isolated oligohydramnios had a higher rate of primary cesarean section compared to the control group.
